title: Revisiting Evaluation Metrics for Semantic Segmentation: Optimization and Evaluation of Fine-grained Intersection over Union
mechanism: Per-image and per-class-per-image mIoU plus worst-case metrics reduce large-object bias; the loss must be computed to match the chosen metric variant.
adaptation: Benchmark: report pooled IoU plus per-cell IoU and worst-k cells per source; loss arm JML per-image vs per-batch.
min_experiment: No training: rescore existing val predictions of SUP100, PF and FINAL with fine-grained and worst-case IoU; adopt as benchmark secondaries if model ranking changes or CIs narrow.
evidence: R: 15 networks on 12 natural and aerial datasets; fine-grained mIoUs reduce large-object bias.
